about: Synthetic sentences for the voice check (night-v3 item 4.5, tumour_board/eval/audio_eval.py). Written in the system's own words; no real patient, no real person of this project. must_keep: the numbers, units, dates, staging and receptor tokens that must come back exactly after the service's clean-up (compared case-insensitively, hyphens and spaces inside a token ignored). accept: spelling pairs counted as equal in the normalised word error rate, the system's form first. A check on a synthetic set, never an accuracy claim.
